//: THE canonical funding vocabulary for the whole billing feature (billing namespace), at the feature root rather than inside a component folder — every card, row and sheet renders these exact words. THE RULE: if a string names a method, a state, an amount or an action, it belongs here; if it narrates a flow (consent, verifying, success, failure, confirm), it belongs to that sheet's own namespace. Point counts are fixed by MethodBenefits' ROWS (credits + payg: 2, monthlyBudget: 3) — change both together. {{surcharge}} = formatted PAYG.SURCHARGE_CENTS.

credits.title: Prepaid credits
credits.tagline: Buy credits that fund the shares of your business
credits.point1: Only spent when someone shares you
credits.point1Sub: One reward per share of your business
credits.point2Sub: Unused credits stay on your account until you spend them

payg.title: Pay as you go
payg.tagline: When someone shares you, we charge the amount for that share to your card
payg.benefitsTitle: Benefits of pay as you go
payg.cta: Set up pay as you go
payg.point1Sub: Your card is charged only when someone shares you
payg.point2: Nothing to keep an eye on
payg.point2Sub: No topping up and no balance to watch
payg.afterCredits: Used after your credits run out
payg.chargedToCard: Shares are charged to your card. Credits are always used first.

monthlyBudget.title: Monthly top-up
monthlyBudget.tagline: Start every month with a full budget
monthlyBudget.point1Sub: No need to check your balance or top up by hand
monthlyBudget.point2Sub: On the 1st of the month, we charge just what's missing up to your monthly amount
monthlyBudget.point3Sub: Your budget is the maximum you spend in a month
monthlyBudget.chargeLine: At your current balance we'll charge {{amount}} on {{date}}
monthlyBudget.chargeLineZero: At your current balance nothing will be charged on {{date}}
